summary.text: Sean Reid is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 11th Essex District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Reid graduated from Lynn Classical High School, earned an associate degree from North Shore Community College, and earned a bachelor's degree from Amherst College.

His career experience includes interning with the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston's Community Development Department and the Governor's Office, working as a substitute teacher in Lynn Public Schools, serving as a real estate agent, and working as an aide and legislative director for state Sen. Brendan Crighton.
Ballotpedia lists the Lynn Public Schools school board (at-large) among his prior offices.
He took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, succeeding Peter Capano.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Steering, Policy and Scheduling, Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery Joint, Public Health Joint, and Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy Joint committees.
